text:
Jonah Park: Observed confusing client signals this morning when traffic hits fallback paths. Some SDKs surface a ThrottleError, others get opaque 500s. Console badges flip between green and red for the same tenant. We need one small surface contract + telemetry tags so SDKs, console, and alerts all agree.

Maya Lin: Totally. Proposing a tiny, explicit schema (no free text): client_status: (OK | RETRYABLE | THROTTLED | FAILED), reason_code: small enum, route_origin: string (but treated as a facet, not a primary metric), visibility: (public | internal), retry_after_ms optional, visible_message_key optional for i18n. Keep visible_message (string) only when visibility=public.

Ravi Singh: +1. A few constraints: 1) route_origin must be aggregated into categories for dashboards (primary/fallback/quantized) to avoid cardinality blowup; 2) visible_message must never contain infra metrics; use visible_message_key -> locale bundles for copywriters.

Maya Lin: Example payload to share with SDKs (compact):

```json
{"error":{"client_status":"THROTTLED","reason_code":"TENANT_QUOTA","retry_after_ms":60000,"route_origin":"eu-central/fallback-small","visibility":"public","visible_message_key":"quota.tenant.exceeded"}}
```

Jonah Park: Nice. SDK mapping rules suggestion: map client_status -> typed exceptions (RETRYABLE -> RetryableError, THROTTLED -> ThrottleError with retry_after accessor, FAILED -> FatalError). If server omits client_status, fallback to legacy mapping (429 -> THROTTLED, 5xx -> FAILED).

Ravi Singh: Telemetry names to standardize: event.client_status, event.reason_code, event.route_category (primary|fallback|quantized), event.tenant_bucket. For rollouts, include a sampled raw_error blob (debug.raw_error) for initial validation.

ops-bot: Feature flag created: client-surface-contract-v1. Canary enabled for eng-platform at 2024-04-10T10:00Z.

Maya Lin: Rollout plan: per-tenant flag. Stage 1: 5% sampled traffic for 48h with raw_error sampling + dashboard diff. Stage 2: 25% for 72h with alert gates (if >3% absolute increase in FAILED or >7% increase in SDK-surfaced ThrottleErrors, rollback). Stage 3: ramp to 100% if stable. Provide kill-switch timeline in RFC.

Jonah Park: Console wants a deterministic badge mapping table (green: OK, yellow: RETRYABLE/THROTTLED, red: FAILED) and runbook links for each state. Also request microcopy variants per locale key; include them in RFC.

Ravi Singh: I'll own dashboard aggregation (route_origin -> route_category) and alerts. Maya, can you own the RFC + i18n key list? Jonah, can you coordinate SDK PR?

Maya Lin: Yep. Drafting RFC now: rfc/1728888888-client-surface-and-badge-mapping.md. Will include schema, examples, telemetry names, rollout checklist, and sample locale keys. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Jonah Park: Great. Ping once the RFC is up and I'll open the SDK PR and tests. Thanks! :thumbsup:
